title: How the Orvan grain corridor worked, and why its ending matters

facts.subject: Corridor Agreement
facts.statement: The Corridor Agreement was a one-year arrangement signed on 10 September 2025.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Corridor Agreement was a one-year arrangement signed on 10 September 2025.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: Under the agreement, sea exports ran at about 95% of the old normal.

source_ref.text_snippet: Under the agreement, sea exports ran at about 95% of the old normal.

facts.subject: Corridor Agreement
facts.statement: Talks on renewal failed, and the port moved onto the general rules with no replacement arrangement.

source_ref.text_snippet: Talks on renewal failed, and the port moved onto the general rules with no replacement arrangement.

facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
facts.statement: The Ravik Rail Link can carry grain to Ravik and onward, but its capacity is limited and it cannot move the volumes that the sea route carried.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Ravik Rail Link can carry grain to Ravik and onward, but its capacity is limited and it cannot move the volumes that the sea route carried.

facts.subject: Sea volumes
facts.statement: The result is a cliff in sea volumes followed by a partial overland substitute, not a full recovery.

source_ref.text_snippet: The result is a cliff in sea volumes followed by a partial overland substitute, not a full recovery.
